label: GEMINI_CONTINUOUS4_REPLAY_V1
labels: READ-ONLY replay. No session, no credentials, no order path. REALIZED is not computed here: settlement has not paid and a cost basis is not a profit.

without_refresh.why: apply_fill had no caller in the live loop and the orders@account queue was never drained, so this never moved for the whole window

with_refresh_at_the_yes_0_92_decision.why: NO 0.14 had FILLED and its cancel returned 200 with an empty result. The reconciliation the fix adds observes the NO leg before the next decision instead of after the window.

cancel_seam.consequence_before: the order was dropped from the working set, so a filled position became invisible
cancel_seam.consequence_after: the order stays in the working set and the authoritative refresh decides

completed_pair.label: COST BASIS, NOT A LOSS. Settlement has not paid, so nothing here is REALIZED.

behavioural_difference: Before: every decision in the window was computed against yes_qty 0 / no_qty 0, because CP.plan builds state['inventory'] FROM the Inventory object and that object never moved. The oscillator therefore never saw the NO leg, and no risk gate could refuse a rung on inventory it did not know existed. After: the venue is re-read before every decision and again after cancels when a place is pending, so the YES 0.92 decision is taken against no_qty 0.01 rather than 0.
